create_subclass_of_Initializer: create a subclass of Initializer that implements __call__ to set physics state and return a boolean
implement_call_method: implement the abstract __call__ method on an Initializer subclass to initialize physics with a random state
override_reset_method: override the reset method on an Initializer subclass to restore physics to a default state
review_Initializer_class: review the Initializer base class and its abstract __call__ and reset methods
summarize_Initializer_class: summarize the Initializer abstract base class used for MOMA composer initializers
